summary: The edition has 122 complete guides and 10 screened discoveries. It completes 29 earlier pending guides and details 2 substantive release updates. This edition follows local interview review on Windows and macOS, reference color across shots, editable drum notation and model-assisted tape restoration. The application, weights and media limits are recorded per workflow. Scarlet fixes speaker attribution during transcript corrections and adds a recovery route for export. LocalSR fixes output timestamps and launch issues on macOS 14 and 15. Godot extensions cover live transcription and baked mouth cues. AutoAOV offers per-pass neural denoising with documented limits on depth and motion data. A GitLab transcription prototype and an earlier SourceHut diffusion runner show how hosted recognition and local build dependencies affect the available workflow. Code grants were read in full. Models, services, creative inputs and hardware or software hosts have separate requirements. This edition is based on source review and published documentation. No discovered app was installed or run. The expanded plan covered 63 fields, 399/399 repository-query attempts and 23 model tasks. The repository lane recorded 398 successful, 1 partial and 0 failed queries, with 99 bounded. The model lane recorded 0 failed tasks. Metadata from 533 saved repository pages included 19,204 numeric identities. The complete retained backlog spans 125,439 candidates, including pilot history and 1,062 previously screened guides still pending before this edition. Creative relevance and the complete software grant were checked before including any discovery. Unreviewed and excluded records stay in local research. Live primary research yielded 471 complete usable responses from 567 distinct URL attempts, including a non-GitHub source in each of 63 fields. 3 captures reached the size bound and 93 other sources were inaccessible or unusable. The ecosystem checks cover all 8 configured groups and record available findings and gaps. Evidence labels in this edition are 0 Recommended, 0 Ready to try, 118 Quality unverified, 14 Experimental. Independent use remains unverified for 129 entries. The creative result check remains unverified for 130, and model, service or cost requirements remain unverified for 132. Repository searches returned no saved rows for Learned film, tape and audio restoration, Embodied and tactile interactive art, Multiband art and heritage imaging, Narrated and tactile exhibition interfaces, Learned shot matching and grading. Primary web research for these fields is included in the coverage notes. Updated evidence labels for previous entries: Diffuser (SourceHut) (Quality unverified to Experimental), Arabic Calligraphy for AI Agents (Quality unverified to Experimental), Arclight (Quality unverified to Experimental). 23 model tasks reached the configured response limit of 50 rows. A model record remains a discovery lead until code and use are verified. All saved model-task results were screened as metadata, covering 1,150 rows and 1,150 distinct model identities. The two linked source guides for the vocal denoiser and RCDL have separately verified software grants. The separate watchlist made 69 unsuccessful repository checks. Collection logged 1 enrichment failures. Credential-shaped material in unsealed captures was removed before sealing. The affected source origins and before-and-after hashes remain in private evidence.
